## Summary of the Pull Request

Aligns the recommendation navigation hint with the Agent Pane's existing one-cell content lane instead of the full pane width. The change preserves vertical allocation, card-internal spacing, compact mode, input behavior, localization, and RTL alignment. Adds a Rust render regression and deterministic zero-token packaged E2E coverage mapped to checklist C299.

## References and Relevant Issues

Closes #793

## Detailed Description of the Pull Request / Additional comments

Reuses the recommendation card rectangle's x/width when rendering its navigation hint, while retaining the hint row's y/height. This keeps layout policy in geometry rather than localized text.

## Validation Steps Performed

- Full WTA: 2078 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored.
- Exact publish HEAD `aee3a5126`: build, deploy, freshness, and packaged E2E passed.
- Source/staged/installed `wta.exe` SHA-256 matched: `349703CF...ADDC2`.
- C299 passed in fresh and incremental release reports.
- Existing compact packaged case was attempted twice; its OS-level splitter never reached the historical <=9-row precondition. Compact unit coverage passed and the changed hint path is disabled in compact mode.

## PR Checklist
- [x] Closes #793
- [x] Tests added/passed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Schema updated (if necessary)
